summary: Round 2 frontend verification for Hi Tours. Verified Nordic country pages (redirect + counts), Scandinavia trip detail, homepage Top 10 and Europe tab order, Middle East coming-soon tags, desktop mega-menu, mobile drawer order & disabled coming-soon buttons, comparison section 8 rows, horizontal carousel wheel propagation, destination-only search, sitemap/robots/favicons. 10 of 11 checks pass. One failure: /europe/holidays aggregate count below requested threshold (24 displayed, requirement >= 29).

integration_issues.issue: Shows '24 holidays' / 'Browse 24 package ideas' but requirement expects >= 29 after adding 14 Nordic trips (Norway 10 + Sweden 4 + Finland 3 + Ireland 2). Country facet counts: Norway 9, Sweden 4, Finland 3, Ireland 2, Greece 5, Switzerland 4, France 3, Denmark 2, Italy 2, Germany 1, Netherlands 1. Country facets include all expected 7 countries, but the aggregate holidays list is under-reporting (likely dedup/filter in europeListingData.js not including all 10 Norway trips - showing 9 - plus some Scandinavia combos not aggregated).

action_items: Investigate /europe/holidays aggregator in /app/frontend/src/europeListingData.js: expected count >= 29 after Nordic additions, but UI shows 24. Specifically Norway facet shows 9 while /europe/norway shows 10 trips, so one Norway/Scandinavia trip is missing from the aggregate. Confirm all 14 Nordic trips (and the 3 Scandinavia multi-country combos) are included and consider whether aggregate total should sum to 15 (prior non-Nordic) + 14 Nordic = 29+.
critical_code_review_comments: React warning in console: 'Invalid DOM property fetchpriority. Did you mean fetchPriority?' — occurs on some or . Rename attribute to React-camelCase fetchPriority to silence the warning. Minor.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Only remaining issue is Europe aggregate count (24 vs >=29). All Round 2 UI changes (coming-soon placement, mobile drawer, search, carousels, mega menu, comparison, assets, Nordic pages) verified working on preview URL.
